LanguageData.MT_WreckInspect: Damaged: weapons, shield and assembly are offline. Restore the turret to resume operation. At zero damaged-state hit points, or when deconstructed while damaged, the turret is completely lost with no parts or resources returned.
LanguageData.MT_WreckRestoreDesc: Complete {0:0} construction work to restore the turret to full health. Add the crafting costs of the installed head and modules to the resources spent upgrading them and the base. Restoration requires half of each resource total, rounded up. Installed parts, upgrades and queued work are retained.
LanguageData.MT_WreckRestoreQueued: Restoration is already in the work queue.
LanguageData.MT_WreckRestoreEstimated: Older upgrade spending was not recorded; its share is estimated using the previous upgrade prices.
LanguageData.MT_WreckCannotAttack: Restore the damaged turret before firing.
LanguageData.MT_WreckAssemblyStopped: Restore the damaged turret before assembly can continue.
LanguageData.MT_WreckSupplyTip: Place missing repair materials on the ground near this turret. Materials already delivered, being carried here, or available nearby count toward the cost.
LanguageData.MT_DebugWreckMaterialsNone: No additional repair materials are needed nearby.
LanguageData.MT_DebugWreckMaterialsDropped: Placed {0:N0} repair materials near the turret.
LanguageData.MT_DebugWreckMaterialsPartial: Placed {0:N0} repair materials. More space is needed for the remaining {1:N0}.
